::: {.key-facts}
At the 2022 census, 167,084 people lived in County Donegal, up 5.0% on 2016. It had the 8th largest population of the 26 counties.

Its population in 2022 was 56% of its population in 1841, the last census before the Great Famine.

In 2025, the average monthly rent on a new tenancy in County Donegal was €977, the lowest of the 26 counties.
:::
